text.tspan: How Helm turns a chart into a running release
Release record = one Secret per revision
helm template = render only, nothing is sent. helm upgrade = render + apply + a new revision.
helm rollback 3 = apply revision 3's stored manifest again, saved as a NEW revision. The stored manifest is the OLD input of the next 3-way merge.
